basis_transcoder.js + basis_transcoder.wasm -- vendored
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js  (examples/jsm/libs/basis/, npm tarball three@0.185.1)

Recorded at v4475. RE-VENDORED alongside the rest of vendor/three, see ../../../PROVENANCE.txt for
the r160 -> 0.185.1 re-vendor record and why.

*** NOT ONE OF THESE FILES CARRIES A LICENCE HEADER, AND THE DIRECTORY HAS NO LICENSE FILE. ***
Re-checked directly at 0.185.1: basis_transcoder.js (57,529 bytes) and basis_transcoder.wasm
(527,333 bytes) contain no "copyright", no "Apache", no SPDX tag, in any part of the file. Upstream
still has no examples/jsm/libs/basis/LICENSE either -- same absence as at r160, not a new gap.

WHERE THE ATTRIBUTION ACTUALLY IS: README.md, vendored here beside them, which names
https://github.com/BinomialLLC/basis_universal as the source of the transcoder. That repository's
LICENSE was read FIRST-HAND at v4473 and is recorded in world/reachedLicences.mjs: Apache License
2.0, 201 lines, sha256 065fcf48d6af21c0, appendix filled in as "Copyright 2019-2026 Binomial LLC".

The wasm's own strings corroborate what it is without saying who owns it: BasisFile, isUASTC,
BASISLZ, BasisImageDesc.

*** THE ASSUMPTION THIS RECORD EXISTS TO REFUSE: "it is inside the three.js repository, so it is
three.js's MIT." *** These are BUILT ARTIFACTS OF ANOTHER PROJECT, bundled. gpu/khronosSamples.mjs
records the same shape for sample assets and found two that are not free at all. Here the answer is
benign -- Apache-2.0 -- and it is benign as a READ FACT rather than as an inference from where the
bytes happen to sit.

SIBLINGS THIS LOADER NEEDS, vendored at the same time and also carrying no in-file licence:
  vendor/three/jsm/libs/ktx-parse.module.js  -- donmccurdy/KTX-Parse, MIT, (c) 2020 Don McCurdy
  vendor/three/jsm/libs/zstddec.module.js    -- donmccurdy/zstddec,   MIT, (c) 2020 Don McCurdy
  vendor/three/jsm/loaders/KTX2Loader.js     -- three.js, MIT (see ../../../LICENSE)
  vendor/three/jsm/utils/WorkerPool.js       -- three.js, MIT (see ../../../LICENSE)
Both McCurdy licences were fetched and read first-hand at v4475.

EVERY FILE IS BYTE-IDENTICAL TO UPSTREAM 0.185.1 (re-confirmed at the re-vendor: file sizes above,
re-fetched from the same npm tarball as the rest of this directory). Nothing was rewritten --
KTX2Loader.js keeps its bare `from 'three'` specifier and its relative '../utils/' and '../libs/'
imports, which is why the directory layout mirrors upstream exactly and why the pages that use it
need the import map they already carry for GLTFLoader.
